title: Transformation of Acanthamoeba castellanii with Qiagen SuperFect reagent
author: Morgan Colp
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.s4regv6
materials: 20 μL of Qiagen SuperFect reagent are added to the DNA solution desired for transfection (in this case pGAPDH-EGFP), and mixed by pipetting 5 times.

steps.title: Prepare cell pellet
steps.instruction: Pellet 5 x 10^5 cells by centrifugation at 1000 g for 5 minutes at 4 °C.

steps.title: Resuspend cells
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 500 microlitres of encystment medium (20 mM Tris–HCl [pH 8.8], 100 mM KCl, 8 mM MgSO4, 0.4 mM CaCl2, 1 mM NaHCO3).

steps.title: Transfer cells to culture plate
steps.instruction: Add the cell suspension to one well of a six well culture plate.

steps.title: Prepare DNA/reagent mixture
steps.instruction: Dilute 4 μg of plasmid DNA (in 3 to 6 μL) in 100 μL of encystment medium.

substeps.instruction: Incubate the DNA/reagent mixture for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Add 600 μL of encystment medium to the mixture and mix.

steps.title: Perform transformation
steps.instruction: Add the entire aliquot of the DNA/reagent/medium mixture to the culture dish well containing the cells.

substeps.instruction: Incubate the cells with the DNA and SuperFect reagent for 3 hours at room temperature.

steps.title: Replace medium
steps.instruction: Pipette off the mixture and replace it with 4 mL of growth (PYG) medium.

steps.title: Allow cell recovery
steps.instruction: Allow cells to recover for 24 hours in their typical growth conditions prior to applying selection.

steps.title: Apply initial antibiotic selection
steps.instruction: Apply selection at ~20% of the final antibiotic concentration until growth is observed (e.g., 10 μg/mL Geneticin [G418]).

substeps.instruction: Continue selection until growth is observed, typically taking about a week.
Confirm growth visually when cell density is roughly half of the peak density achieved during regular culturing, or verify with cell counts.

steps.title: Maintain selected cells
steps.instruction: Perform subsequent transfers using the full concentration of antibiotic selection (e.g., 50 μg/mL Geneticin [G418]) for indefinite maintenance.

substeps.instruction: Transfer cells diligently in 2-3 week intervals, or at peak density before significant encystation occurs.
